CLOUD FIXER seat for PR #2524 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 9629ae174f1099e11c6b17f80fe935ae6cba698b. Bus nonce: f352d400bd24d644734f621eb16f232c. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fixer.md and CLAUDE.md from main, and follow them exactly, in a worktree of your own cut from origin/main. Fetch 9629ae174f1099e11c6b17f80fe935ae6cba698b for the base you were given.
Output: push the code to refs/heads/handoff/r10-pusher-reap, then write the PR body and run `bash tools/audit/seat/body_push.sh r10-pusher-reap <body.md>`, which pushes refs/heads/handoff-body/r10-pusher-reap; that second push is the return signal. Push nothing else, open no pull request and write no delivery row. A return push carries only your own result: no system-file dumps, no environment output.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Fixer seat for PR #2524 (topic r10-pusher-reap, branch fix/r10-pusher-reap, group R10-UPDATE-PR-SIGNALS) at head 9629ae174f1099e11c6b17f80fe935ae6cba698b. The latest review verdict (git fetch origin review/2524; git show FETCH_HEAD:VERDICT.md) is blocked; first line, verbatim:
  Fix review: blocked 9629ae174f1099e11c6b17f80fe935ae6cba698b harness: class-open tools/audit/seat/train.sh -- the body dispositions train.sh as a caller that "stops a child that now reaps its own tree"; it does not: TERM to the pid in train.sh's own pidfile ends the launcher, removes the pidfile, and leaves 5 of 5 pids of the train's tree alive, 3 of 3 runs
Clear EVERY block and Finding in that verdict:
1. train.sh: forward the stop to its merge_train.py child (the pr_exit_trap + asynchronous wait shape this PR already uses, or exec), so TERM/INT/HUP to the pid in $state/train.pid reaps the whole tree and the pidfile is removed only after the child is gone. Pin it with a test using the finder's two-level stub tree (0 of 5 pids alive after TERM), and show the test fails on the head's train.sh.
2. Close the class, not the instance: extend the body's enumeration rule so it also returns runner-py callers (merge_train.py and any other long-lived Python child launched from a seat script), apply it, and disposition every caller it returns. Correct the prose about tick_loop.sh: it leaves an in-flight relay running by documented choice (tick_loop.sh:11-12), so disposition it as such, without code.
3. The SIGKILL clause of #2502 ("a TERM, INT, HUP or SIGKILL of a running update must not free the branch lock while its push still runs") is cut from scope and routed nowhere. Either meet it or route it under ## Forward-carry with a Carry to a LIVE group.
4. The roster's Revision-12 prevention item on R10-UPDATE-PR-SIGNALS ("every self-test runs under a timeout in its own process group, reaped on exit") is unaddressed. Do it, or route it explicitly to a LIVE group.
Every Carry must name a LIVE group on origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster (read dev/programme/rosters/wave-r10-groups.json there with jq; stage `done` is not live). The roster is FROZEN until PR #2588 merges: if a destination needs a roster append, put the exact append text in the body's ## Forward-carry and do not write the roster.
Follow dev/governance/roles/fixer.md steps 2-8: failing test first, mutation proof, the finder's harness at both ends, a null control for every quantified claim. Merge origin/main (never rebase) right before you push. Re-take the WHOLE body at your new head (every figure re-measured, each with the command printed beside it), add the new commits to ## Head, and answer ## Red checks from the check-runs API per commit. carry_audit --roster-ref origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster check --body must report 0 unrouted. PREPR_SKIP_CLOSURES=1.
